acos.detail: reset request wall on a held session, readiness proved by the reply's fresh frame and a post-reset tree read

legacy.source: iter/D2.md via BENCHMARKS.md 3 (legacy reset --app -> first fresh frame, 748.1 ms p50, warm; the command alone is 110.3 ms)

reasons: acos p50 681.792 is within noise of legacy 748.1 (tie = not pass)

serve's `acos_reset` (kill the guest, relaunch the same APK with empty app-data, bind a fresh frame) timed request-write to reply; the reply is only sent once the fresh frame is bound, so this IS reset -> ready. Readiness + correctness bound per sample: frame_seq > previous_frame_seq, the app was tapped to a non-zero count first, and the tree after the reset reads 0 (10/10 ok). Legacy's reset-command-only value (110.3 ms) is reported in the reason only, never substituted.
